articles.title: Trump 'low-key' bets on economic pressure against Iran
articles.content: Keeping a low profile doesn't come naturally to Donald Trump. "We are low-keying it," Trump told news site Axios by phone Sunday. "We're only semi-negotiating with them. We are just watching Iran with its huge inflation and the fact they have no money.". "Iran is broke, totally broke and they're not paying their soldiers," Trump said Monday in the Oval Office

articles.title: MHA alerts public to fake websites impersonating 7 Home Team agencies, itself
articles.content: The seven Home Team agencies are: the Singapore Police Force (SPF), Central Narcotics Bureau (CNB), Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF), Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA), Singapore Prison Service (SPS), Home Team Science and Technology Agency (HTX), and Home Team Academy (HTA). "(This) could have potentially misled members of the public into believing that they were accessing official MHA or Home Team agency websites," it said.
